O.outcome_detail: team collaboration and satisfaction about care decisions

result.effect: All CSACD item differences p < 0.001; pre-intervention means 4.82–5.77 and post-intervention means 6.37–6.60

cells.quote: The intervention significantly improved the participants’ team collaboration and satisfaction about care decisions, as demonstrated in Table 2. The mean pre-intervention scores for each item ranged from 4.82 to 5.77, while the mean post-intervention scores ranged from 6.37 to 6.6. All differences were significant (p < 0.001).
cells.note: The workshop combined practical simulations, theoretical learning, debriefing, and video-based discussions; the pre-post effect cannot be attributed to simulation alone.

O.outcome_detail: clinical teamwork, communication, situational awareness, decision-making, and role responsibility

result.effect: Overall teamwork 3.16 ± 1.20 to 7.61 ± 1.09; overall decision-making 3.50 ± 1.54 to 7.16 ± 1.42; overall role responsibility 2.50 ± 1.54 to 8.66 ± 1.02; all reported p < 0.001

cells.quote: The intervention also positively affected all overall measures of performance per the CTS. Overall teamwork and team communication scores increased from 3.16 ± 1.20 to 7.61 ± 1.09 and 3.16 ± 1.24 to 7.61 ± 1.28, respectively (p < 0.001). Overall situational awareness rating significantly improved from 2.66 ± 2.05 to 7.27 ± 1.48, decision-making rating rose from 3.50 ± 1.54 to 7.16 ± 1.42, while overall role responsibility rating improved from 2.50 ± 1.54 to 8.66 ± 1.02 (p < 0.001) (Table 3).
cells.note: The same evaluators rated pre- and post-training performances and were not blinded to timing.
